hero_sub: Got an SMS, a WhatsApp message or a call about money that feels off? Paste it here. Five AI agents check it against real scam reports and public alerts, argue the other side, and tell you why.
paste_placeholder: Paste the SMS or WhatsApp message, or describe the call…
sender_placeholder: Number or name shown on your phone (optional)
steps: The critic argues the other side
privacy: Your number is never stored. Numbers in the message become a code before anything is saved.
stat_reports: real scam reports and alerts behind every answer
campaign_badge: Part of a scam campaign: {n} linked records
how_we_checked: For experts: every step the agents took
share_text: I checked this message on CheckAm: {verdict}. Before you send, check it:
how_title: Five agents. One answer you can check.
how_sub: No black box. Every claim on your verdict points to the record behind it.
agent_intake: Reads your message or screenshot, finds numbers, links and what it asks of you. Spots tricks aimed at fooling AI.
agent_planner: Decides what to look up for this message.
agent_investigator: Searches scam reports, public alerts and real operator messages, and links your message to known campaigns.
agent_critic: Re-checks every number itself and argues the message is genuine. Nothing weak gets through.
agent_reporter: Writes your answer in plain English or French, with safe next steps from official channels only.
alerts_sub: Published by fraud analysts from campaigns that people's checks helped uncover. Each alert is signed: you can verify it really comes from CheckAm.
analyst_title: For fraud teams, CERT and fact-checkers
analyst_sub: Every check feeds a campaign graph. Analysts see linked reports, alerts and citizen checks, read an evidence dossier and publish signed alerts.
install_sub: Install it like an app. On Android, from any SMS or WhatsApp message, tap Share → CheckAm. On any phone, copy the message and tap Paste, or forward it to @checkam_bot on Telegram.
install_ios: On iPhone: in Safari tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. To check a message, copy it and tap Paste, send a screenshot, or add CheckAm to your Share menu (steps under the message box).
footer_data: Built on Stop Arnaque 237, an open dataset of real scams reported in Cameroon.
error: Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.

ask_sender_sub: Type the name or number shown at the top of the message on your phone. With it, the agents can usually give a clear answer.
rc_valid: ✓ Signed by CheckAm: this answer is real
rc_invalid: ✗ This is not a real CheckAm answer
rc_forged: Someone changed this answer, or made it up. Do not trust the screenshot you were shown.
rc_match: Have the message? Paste it here to confirm it is the one CheckAm checked.
rc_same: ✓ Same message. This answer is about the message you have.
rc_different: ✗ Different message. This answer is about another one: check yours.
rc_how: Every CheckAm answer is signed with CheckAm's key, so a screenshot can be faked but this page cannot. The message itself is never shown here.
rc_missing_title: No CheckAm answer has this number
rc_missing: The link may be mistyped, or someone made it up. Only links from checkam.me lead to real answers.

ios_share_title: Add CheckAm to your iPhone Share menu (once, 1 minute)
ios_share_steps: Open the Shortcuts app and tap + to make a new shortcut.
Tap the ⓘ button and turn on Show in Share Sheet. Under Receive, keep only Text.
Add the action URL Encode. It encodes the Shortcut Input.
Add the action Open URLs and type https://checkam.me/?text= then insert URL Encoded Text right after it.
Name it CheckAm. Now in Messages, WhatsApp or Mail: press and hold a message, tap Share, then CheckAm.
ios_share_other: No time now? Copy the message and tap Paste above, send a screenshot, or forward it to
flag_ask: Tell us what you know. A fraud analyst will review it; your answer stays as it is until then.
flag_note: Optional: what makes you think so
flag_thanks: Thank you. A fraud analyst will review it, and what they confirm helps the next person.
